The hypothesis and expression concern V05's year-over-year change, standardized against its own expanding history, and predict a reversal. The claims are a migration report about a different feature: an interaction of two stress-type variables, a word-limit failure, and a regime-conditioned pay-and-hours interaction. None of them is referenced or tested by the hypothesis or expression, and neither cites any claim numbers.
